This role serves as a critical bridge between business stakeholders, functional subject matter experts, and technical data teams to define, validate, maintain, and continuously improve operational metrics and reporting outputs. The position drives proactive data quality monitoring, supports KPI issue resolution, enables clear performance communications for leadership forums, and contributes business context to the design and adoption of new metrics as organizational needs evolve. Main Responsibilities Own the stewardship of Service Supply Chain Operational Performance KPIs, including definition, enablement, maintenance, accuracy, timeliness, and ongoing relevance to business needs. Serve as the subject matter expert for performance metrics, bridging business requirements and technical implementation across Service Supply Chain functional SMEs and the Data Enablement organization. Lead the identification, prioritization, and resolution of KPI-related issues, ensuring root causes are understood and corrective actions are implemented effectively. Execute proactive quality assurance for Operational KPIs through regular monitoring, validation, and tracking of metric health, data integrity, and reporting accuracy. Communicate KPI issues, risks, dependencies, and resolution plans clearly and proactively to functional stakeholders, business owners, and technical partners. Evaluate and propose improvements to metric logic, reporting processes, automation, data quality controls, and governance practices to increase accuracy, efficiency, and scalability. Provide guidance to business owners and stakeholders on KPI interpretation, metric definitions, performance trends, and appropriate use of reporting outputs. Partner with cross-functional teams to document metric definitions, business rules, ownership models, assumptions, limitations, and governance processes. Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying reporting gaps, process inefficiencies, and opportunities to enhance performance visibility and decision-making. Manages priority projects by adding creative insights and developing recommendations. Mentors junior-level staff and establishes guidelines for the mentorship programs. Education & Experience Recommended Four-year or Graduate Degree in Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing Engineering, Operations management, Business Administration, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence. Typically has 7-10 years of work experience, preferably in supply chain, operations, or a related field. Experience And Qualifications Strong understanding of end-to-end supply chain operations, preferably within services, support, or regional operations environments. Demonstrated experience working with operational performance metrics, KPI governance, business rules, and data quality management. Experience translating business requirements into metric logic, reporting specifications, dashboards, or analytical outputs. Proficiency with Power BI, including report development, data visualization, metric validation, and dashboard usability best practices. Working knowledge of data management concepts, database structures, data validation, and reporting data flows. Strong automation and process improvement mindset, with experience using tools such as Power Automate, Power Query, Excel, SQL, or similar technologies preferred. Ability to analyze complex data issues, identify root causes, and partner with technical teams to drive sustainable resolutions. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences. Process-oriented mindset with demonstrated ability to standardize, document, and improve recurring operational processes. Lean Six Sigma, process improvement, analytics, or data governance certifications are a plus. Impact & Scope Impacts function and leads and/or provides expertise to functional project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. Description: About The Role RPMGlobal (RPM) is seeking a Computer Vision and machine learning Software Engineer to join our development team and develop algorithms that transform imagery, LiDAR, point clouds, and other sensor data into accurate and actionable information about the physical world. You will work on challenging problems across Computer Vision, machine learning, and 3D geometry, building capabilities used to understand large-scale mining and industrial environments. Your work will go beyond research and prototypes, bringing algorithms into reliable production systems running across cloud and edge environments. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys combining algorithms, machine learning, and strong software engineering to solve complex real-world problems. This is a full-time role, and while it is remote, candidates must be based in Guadalajara. To be considered for this role, please submit your application in English. Key Responsibilities Research, design and implement Computer Vision and machine learning algorithms using C++ and Python. Work on 3D vision problems, including SLAM, Structure from Motion, etc. Train, evaluate, and optimise Machine Learning and Deep Learning models, from dataset preparation/experimentation through production deployment. Optimise algorithms for accuracy, performance, and scalability across cloud, on-premise, and edge environments. Collaborate with development teams and product managers to integrate Computer Vision and Machine Learning capabilities into customer-facing products. Contribute to architecture, code reviews, automated testing, and development standards. About You Relevant tertiary education, such as a Master of Science or PhD in computer science, Computer Vision, robotics, machine learning, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience. Experience with LiDAR, point clouds, photogrammetry, SLAM, Structure from Motion, pose estimation, or 3D reconstruction. Strong proficiency in C++ and Python, including performance optimisation, memory management, data structures, and algorithms. Exposure to working with libraries and technologies such as OpenCV, PCL, CUDA, OpenCL, or OpenMP. Experience developing and training Deep Learning models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. Ability to optimise Computer Vision or machine learning workloads for GPU and high-performance computing environments. Experience with Docker, CI/CD, and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Ability to work with large datasets and design robust evaluation methodologies, metrics, and validation workflows. Strong software engineering practices, including code reviews, version control, automated testing, debugging, and profiling. Fluency in Spanish and English. Legally entitled to work in Mexico. Highly Regarded Qualifications And Experience Experience with geospatial applications, coordinate systems, spatial analysis, or large-scale mapping workflows. Experience with autonomous systems, robotics, drones, or multi-sensor platforms. Experience in mining, construction, autonomous systems, robotics, or other industrial environments. About RPM RPMGlobal is the mining industry’s leading enterprise technology and training provider and has been at the forefront of change and innovation in the mining industry for over 50 years. We advance the mining industry towards a safer, more efficient, and more sustainable future through the delivery of innovative software solutions and deep domain mining expertise. Guided by our underlying principles of mining expertise, innovation, and sustainability, we strive to create safer and more efficient operations for our mining customers. Our focus on providing advanced mining enterprise technology and training across the mining lifecycle enables us to guide customers through the industry's current and emerging challenges worldwide. This includes helping them meet the shift in social norms and consumer and investor ESG-related expectations. Please, no agencies or recruiters.
